newsitem.title: USA: Westamerica insiders sell 52 pct stake.
newsitem.headline: Westamerica insiders sell 52 pct stake.

text.p: WestAmerica Corp on Thursday said its chairman and a director agreed to sell 52 percent of the company's outstanding shares to Capital Investment Partners Inc.
The sale involves all of the WestAmerica common shares held by the chairman, Edward Foraker, and director W.F. Groszkruger, WestAmerica said in a statement. Further detials were undisclosed.
Capital Investment, a private investment banking firm, is currently financing Sportsworld 2000 Resort Inc, a sports theme park planned for Orlando, Florida.
WestAmerica also said a one-for-three reverse stock split went into effect on July 2.
